name: calit
description: Self-hosted, multi-user Calendly alternative. Scheduling you own

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database (postgres) and this install's own keys (state/secrets.env). Back this folder up; Google connections can't be read without the keys.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: calit web pages (booking pages and dashboard), published on host as 6137

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PUBLIC_URL
variables.description: The address people open your booking pages at. Every booking link and email link starts with it. It starts as localhost, which only works on this device: change `localhost` to your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6137, or set your https address. Keep the port at 6137 unless you use a domain.

variables.name: MAIL_HOST
variables.description: Your email server, like smtp.gmail.com. calit sends every booking confirmation, reminder and password reset by email. Left blank, bookings still work but nobody gets an email; the mail waits and goes out once you set this.

variables.name: MAIL_USERNAME
variables.description: The user name for your email server, usually your email address.

variables.name: MAIL_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for your email server. For Gmail, use an app password.

variables.name: MAIL_FROM
variables.description: The address emails come from, like calit@example.com.
